# eduMentora (Edumentora Services LLP)

> Academic credit transfer institution based in Kerala, India (offices in Calicut and Kochi). Helps students who discontinued a UG, PG, Diploma, or B.Tech program transfer previously earned credits to UGC/AICTE-recognized partner universities and resume their degree without starting over.

Contact: info@edumentora.com | +91 974458 7777

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.edumentora.com/): Overview of Edumentora's services, partner universities, and student testimonials.
- [About Us](https://www.edumentora.com/about-us): Who Edumentora is and how the credit transfer process works, with FAQs.
- [B.Tech Credit Transfer](https://www.edumentora.com/b-tech-credit-transfer): Main program page for engineering credit transfer, including eligibility, partner universities, and FAQs.
- [UG Credit Transfer](https://www.edumentora.com/ug-credit-transfer)
- [PG Credit Transfer](https://www.edumentora.com/pg-credit-transfer)
- [Diploma Credit Transfer](https://www.edumentora.com/diploma-credit-transfer)
- [Apprenticeship Learning Program](https://www.edumentora.com/apprenticeship-learning-program)
- [Programmes](https://www.edumentora.com/programs): Full list of available academic programs.
- [Partner Universities](https://www.edumentora.com/universities): Recognized universities Edumentora works with.
- [Blog](https://www.edumentora.com/blog): Articles on education and career topics.
- [Gallery](https://www.edumentora.com/gallery): Photos from events and campus life.
- [Contact](https://www.edumentora.com/contact): Office locations (Calicut, Kochi) and enquiry form.

## Location-specific B.Tech Credit Transfer pages

Dedicated pages for B.Tech credit transfer guidance in: Alappuzha, Ernakulam, Idukki, Kochi, Kannur, Kasaragod, Kollam, Kottayam, Kozhikode, Malappuram, Palakkad, Pathanamthitta, Thiruvananthapuram, Thrissur, and Wayanad — all under `https://www.edumentora.com/b-tech-credit-transfer-<city>`.
